name: Flutter

description: مسار Flutter في CAT Reloaded: رحلة منظمة أسبوعًا بأسبوع من Dart والموبايل حتى Firestore والمدفوعات والـ CI/CD، مع مشروع تطبيقي في كل مرحلة.

modules.name: Introduction to Flutter & Dart Basics
objectives: Set up Dart and write your first program.
Learn how to handle user input, variables, data types, and operators.
Practice string operations and understand control flow using conditionals and loops.
Build a strong foundation in Dart before diving into Flutter.

modules.name: Dart Collections, Functions & Null Safety
objectives: Learn how to use Dart’s core collection types: List, Set, and Map.
Write reusable code using functions.
Understand null safety and how Dart prevents null-related errors.
Handle runtime issues gracefully through error handling techniques.

topics.title: Week 2 – Dart Collections, Functions & Null Safety

resources.title: Week 2 – Dart Collections, Functions & Null Safety
Collections (List, Set, Map) – Dart language guide

modules.name: Object-Oriented Programming in Dart
objectives: Understand the fundamentals of OOP (object-oriented programming) and how it applies in Dart.
Create classes, constructors, and objects, and explore methods and attributes.
Apply encapsulation, abstraction (using abstract classes and interfaces), inheritance, polymorphism, mixins, and enums.
Write more organized and maintainable Dart code using OOP principles.

modules.name: Continue OOP Concepts & Version Control with Git & GitHub
objectives: Deepen your understanding of OOP concepts through a practical series by Omar Ahmed.
Learn version control fundamentals: setting up Git, managing repositories, and collaborating with GitHub.

modules.name: Final Project & Setting Up Flutter
objectives: Make sure to catch up on any topics you may have missed from previous weeks to ensure you're ready for the final project.
Make the final project of the level, which will apply the concepts learned throughout the beginner level. _(Details to be added later.)_
Install Flutter and set up your development environment.
Verify that everything is working properly by running your first Flutter app.

modules.name: Flutter UI Basics & Layout Widgets
objectives: Set up and use a Virtual Device (Emulator) for testing Flutter apps.
Understand the difference between StatelessWidget and StatefulWidget.
Learn the structure of a Flutter app using runApp, MaterialApp, and Scaffold.
Explore common UI components such as AppBar, Drawer, Text, Container, Column, and Row.

modules.name: Images, Layouts & Positioning
objectives: Learn how to display and manage images from assets and gallery (using image_picker).
Understand and use CircleAvatar for profile images.
Master layout control widgets like Center, SizedBox, Card, Stack, Expanded, IndexedStack, Wrap, and Divider.
Build visually balanced UIs using positioning, overflow handling, and widget fitting.

modules.name: Buttons, Forms & Themes
objectives: Learn how to use interactive buttons, gestures, and input fields in Flutter.
Work with forms, validation, and input decoration.
Customize your app’s theme and typography to achieve a custom look.

modules.name: Lists, Navigation & Page Management
objectives: Master the use of ListView and GridView widgets for building scrollable layouts.
Learn to work with tabs, navigation bars, and page views for better app structure.
Understand Flutter’s navigation system using routes and the Navigator class.

topics.title: Intermediate Week 4 – Lists, Navigation & Page Management

resources.title: Intermediate Week 4 – Lists, Navigation & Page Management

modules.name: Advanced UI Components & App Polish
objectives: Work with advanced UI widgets like sliders, dropdowns, and dialogs.
Learn to use SearchDelegate for in-app searching.
Add custom launch icons and native splash screens to make your app production-ready.

topics.title: Intermediate Week 5 – Advanced UI & App Polish

resources.title: Intermediate Week 5 – Advanced UI & App Polish

modules.name: Local Database with Sqflite
objectives: Understand how to store, retrieve, and manage data locally in Flutter using the sqflite package.
Learn the full workflow of creating, updating, and deleting records.
Build a small Notes App to practice basic database operations.

topics.title: Intermediate Week 6 – Sqflite Database in Flutter

resources.title: Intermediate Week 6 – Sqflite Database in Flutter
Using SQLite in Flutter with sqflite

modules.name: Networking & API Integration
objectives: Learn how to fetch and send data over the internet using the http package.
Understand GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests.
Build and display data from a remote API in your Flutter app.

topics.title: Intermediate Week 7 – Flutter Networking & API Integration

resources.title: Intermediate Week 7 – Flutter Networking & API Integration

modules.name: State Management with Provider
objectives: Understand why state management is essential for scalable Flutter apps — how state represents your app’s data and UI, and why managing it efficiently improves p
Learn the fundamentals of Flutter’s reactive model and how widgets rebuild when state changes.
Master the Provider package, including ChangeNotifier, Consumer, Selector, and context methods.

topics.title: Intermediate Week 8 – State Management with Provider

resources.title: Intermediate Week 8 – State Management with Provider
Understanding State Management in Flutter – Official Docs
Simple App State Management with Provider

modules.name: Advanced State Management with BLoC
objectives: Understand why large apps need structured architecture, predictable data flow, and separation of concerns.
Learn the core principles behind the BLoC (Business Logic Component) pattern, including streams, events, and states.
Apply Cubit and BLoC to real scenarios such as theming, connectivity monitoring, API fetching, and infinite scrolling.
Learn how to use Freezed for immutable state classes and code generation.
Build a foundation that prepares you for clean architecture, layered design, and large-scale applications.

modules.name: Firebase Authentication & Firestore CRUD
objectives: Understand Firebase setup in Flutter projects.
Implement user authentication with email/password and Google Sign-In.
Learn basic and advanced Firestore operations: add, read, delete, update, set, subcollections, filtering, transactions, and batch operations.
Handle loading states effectively in your Flutter apps.

modules.name: File Upload & Cloud Messaging
objectives: Implement real-time data streams with StreamBuilder.
Learn file upload and image handling using Firebase Storage.
Integrate Cloud Messaging for push notifications, handling foreground, background, and terminated states.
Handle notification interactions with onMessageOpenedApp and getInitialMessage.

modules.name: Animation Basics
objectives: Understand the role of animations in improving user experience.
Learn the difference between:
Implicit animations (simple, built-in transitions).
Explicit animations using animation controllers.
Work with common Flutter animation widgets such as:
AnimatedContainer
AnimatedOpacity
TweenAnimationBuilder
Use AnimationController, Tween, and Curves to build custom animations.
Apply animations to page transitions, lists, and UI interactions in real apps.

modules.name: SOLID Principles & Clean Code
objectives: Understand the SOLID principles and how to apply them in Flutter development:
Single Responsibility Principle (SRP)
Open-Closed Principle (OCP)
Liskov Substitution Principle (LSP)
Interface Segregation Principle (ISP)
Dependency Inversion Principle (DIP)
Learn the core concepts of clean code to write readable, maintainable, and scalable Flutter applications:
Writing meaningful names
Organizing functions and classes
Proper use of comments
Code formatting and structure
Handling errors and boundaries
Using objects and data structures effectively

topics.title: SOLID Principles in Arabic – Omar Ahmed

resources.title: SOLID Principles in Arabic – Omar Ahmed

modules.name: MVVM & Clean Architecture
objectives: Understand MVVM architecture in Flutter and how to separate concerns:
View – UI layer
ViewModel – Business logic and state management
Model – Data layer
Implement Repository pattern and Dependency Injection (DI) for scalable apps
Connect MVVM with API projects for real-world applications
Learn Clean Architecture principles in Flutter:
Structure projects into Domain, Data, and Presentation layers
Implement Entities, Repositories, and Use Cases
Connect Blocs or State Management with the presentation layer
Apply Dependency Injection and maintain separation of concerns
Build UI pages for posts, add/update, and detail views

modules.name: Maps & Google Map Integration
objectives: Understand the basics of maps in Flutter and how they work.
Learn about map service providers and map tiles.
Configure Google Maps for Flutter, including API keys and integration steps.
Handle permissions required for location services using Flutter.
Build interactive Google Maps in your Flutter projects.

resources.title: Introduction to Maps & Google Map Integration

modules.name: Payment Integration with Paymob
objectives: Understand the basics of electronic payment gateways.
Integrate Paymob payment gateway in Flutter applications.
Handle payment requests, responses, and transactions.
Build a complete payment flow from initiation to confirmation in your app.
Learn best practices for secure payment handling in Flutter.

resources.title: Handling Transactions & Payment States in Flutter

modules.name: Open-Source Contribution & Package Publishing
objectives: Understand the importance of open-source contributions in Flutter and Dart.
Learn how to create, structure, and publish Flutter/Dart packages to pub.dev.
Gain practical experience with forking, cloning, and contributing to open-source projects.
Follow best practices for documentation, testing, and versioning in packages.
Improve collaboration skills through pull requests, code reviews, and issue tracking.

modules.name: Testing in Flutter
objectives: Understand the importance of testing in Flutter applications.
Learn the different types of tests:
Unit Tests – Test individual functions, classes, or methods.
Widget Tests – Test UI components and widget behavior.
Use Flutter’s testing framework and tools effectively.
Run tests and interpret test results to ensure code quality.

topics.title: Flutter Unit & Widget Testing - Mohamed Waleed

resources.title: Flutter Unit & Widget Testing - Mohamed Waleed

modules.name: CI/CD, Flavors & App Distribution
objectives: Understand the CI/CD workflow in mobile and Flutter development.
Learn how to configure Flutter build flavors for:
Development
Production
Automate builds using GitHub Actions.
Distribute pre-release builds to testers using Firebase App Distribution.
Explore Fastlane to automate Android and iOS release processes.
